apiKey_help: Your personal key for the Meteonomiqs Public Weather API. It is stored encrypted.
enableAstro_help: Sunrise, sunset, twilight, day length, moonrise, moon phase.
enableCurrent_help: Values of the hour in progress, refreshed every hour from the existing hourly states — no extra API call. Requires hourly values.
enableExtended_help: Useful for comparing against a local weather station and for ventilation logic.
enableHourly_help: Creates many objects. On low-powered hardware one day is a good compromise.
enableJson_help: forecast_json and hourly_json for VIS, jarvis and Material widgets.
enableSnow_help: Snow line and fresh snow. Mainly relevant at altitude or in winter.
enableSpaces_help: Morning, afternoon, evening and night per day.
enableWarnings_help: Group, text and severity 0-4 — ideal for automations without string comparisons.
forecastDays_help: 1 to 14. Reducing the value deletes the day folders that are no longer needed.
httpTimeout_help: The response is large; on slow hardware 20 seconds is a sensible minimum.
info_budget: The counter is a local estimate — the API does not report the remaining quota. HTTP 429 is the only ground truth.
info_data: All data comes from one and the same API response — enabling more groups does not cost extra calls, only more objects.
info_schedule: Each fetch consumes one API call. Enter the times as HH:MM.
info_tier: Priority = how many fetches per day the remaining budget must still support for this entry to run. When the budget gets tight the highest number is dropped first, so priority 1 keeps running the longest.
language_help: Applies to the weather descriptions delivered by the API. Unsupported languages fall back to German.
maxRetries_help: Only for network errors and HTTP 5xx. Each retry costs one API call.
minHoursBetweenUpdates_help: Protects against restart loops. Must be smaller than the shortest gap between two update times, otherwise a fetch is skipped every day.
monthlyLimit_help: Allowance of your plan. The free plan offers 100. Enter 0 to disable the check.
reserveCalls_help: Kept free for manual updates. Automatic retries never touch this reserve.
updateTimes_help: Suggestion: 01:10 for the day ahead, 11:40 as a correction before the critical afternoon, 18:40 for the night and tomorrow.
useSystemLocation_help: Latitude and longitude are taken from Settings → System → Location.
